check_box.label: Enable Cinematic Camera
check_box.name: CinematicCamEnabled
check_box.tool_tip: Takes over the camera. Uncheck to return to the normal camera.

check_box.label: Target selected avatar
check_box.name: CinematicCamUseSelected
check_box.tool_tip: Follow the selected avatar instead of yourself (falls back to you if nothing valid is selected)

check_box.label: Frame head
check_box.name: CinematicCamLookAtHead
check_box.tool_tip: Patterns aim at the head joint instead of chest height

check_box.label: Handheld operator
check_box.name: CinematicCamUseOperator
check_box.tool_tip: Route the cinematic camera through the procedural handheld operator for organic texture

spinner.label: Dutch
spinner.name: CinematicCamDutchAngle
spinner.tool_tip: Dutch (tilt) angle in deg, applied to every mode. 0 = level

combo_box.name: FlycamOperatorLocomotionMode
combo_box.tool_tip: What the operator is physically DOING, as distinct from the rig they are holding. Legacy keeps the old Motion Profile behaviour. Selecting a mode replaces that axis; it never overwrites your tuned settings.

check_box.label: Fisheye
check_box.name: CineFisheyeEnabled
check_box.tool_tip: Enable the fisheye and circular peephole post effect over any camera mode

spinner.label: Blend (s)
spinner.name: FlycamOperatorModeBlendTime
spinner.tool_tip: Seconds to cross-fade between locomotion modes. Changing mode mid-shot ramps instead of snapping.

spinner.label: Simulation Hz
spinner.name: FlycamOperatorSimulationHz
spinner.tool_tip: Fixed simulation rate for opted-in locomotion modes. Legacy keeps its original variable-frame path.

button.label: Reset Mode
button.name: btn_reset_mode
button.tool_tip: Reset the current mode's parameters to their defaults

button.label: Reset All
button.name: btn_reset_all
button.tool_tip: Reset the shared settings and every mode's parameters to their defaults

combo_box.name: CinematicCamMotionStartMode
combo_box.tool_tip: Classic uses the legacy region/facing start; Facing is subject-relative; Camera begins at the shot-start view; Explicit uses Offset; Random is seeded

spinner.label: Offset
spinner.name: CinematicCamMotionStartOffsetDeg
spinner.tool_tip: Degrees from subject facing, or absolute region azimuth in Explicit mode

combo_box.name: CinematicCamMotionDirection
combo_box.tool_tip: CW/CCW reverse rotational motion; lateral modes use the corresponding reverse/forward travel sign

spinner.label: Seed
spinner.name: CinematicCamMotionSeed
spinner.tool_tip: 0 auto-derives deterministically from shot identity; nonzero locks the authored seed

combo_box.name: CinematicCamJoint
